text: Alla Toowɗo O na filloo, O wii malaykaaɓe ɓe: Kanko maa O waɗ yimɓe lomtondirooɓe dow leydi ndi, ngam ɓe nguurnira ndi dewe Alla, malaykaaɓe ɓe naamnii joomii ɓe - naamnal laɓɓinagol - holko woni ñeeñal waɗude ɓiɓɓe-aadama lomtoo dow leydi, tawa eɓe mbonna ndi, ɓe ndufa ƴiiƴe e tooñe, ɓe mbii: minen ko min rewooɓe Ma tan, ko min sennooɓe yettooɓe Ma, miɗen teddina mawngu Maa e timmal Maa, min ceerataa heen, Alla jaabii ɓe naamnal maɓɓe: Miin Miɗo anndi ko on nganndaa e ñeeñe mawɗe ko ɓe tagiraa, e paandale lomtineede ɓe.
